title: 热面包卷和两声铃响  (Warm Rolls and Two Rings)

segments.t: Five minutes later, the warm scent of fresh bread drifts out from the breakfast corner at Courtyard Inn. Morning baker Mei carries over a basket of hot rolls to meet Qing and Chen. Let's listen in first.
你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
所以老房子自己会打招呼？
没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
'Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.'
你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
'Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!'
刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
'Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.'
谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
'Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?'
跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
'With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.'
小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
'Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.'
因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
'Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!'
那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
'What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!'
那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
'Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.'
就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
'Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.'
所以老房子自己会打招呼？
'So the old house says hello by itself?'
没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
'Exactly! You already fit right in here.'
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.

Qing has a warm roll in her hand and an instant friend in the café corner. You will hear casual and polite greetings side by side in every episode. See you next time.
